arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
english: Seek help through patience and prayer — and indeed, it is heavy except for the humble.

arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ
english: Indeed, prayer restrains from indecency and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater.

arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
english: Indeed, I am Allah; there is no god but Me — so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
english: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves — do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

arabic: إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّاكِرِينَ
english: Indeed, good deeds wipe away misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.

arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا
english: Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers at appointed times.

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
english: When My servants ask you about Me — indeed, I am near. I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.

arabic: أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ
english: Establish prayer from the decline of the sun until the darkness of night, and the recitation of dawn.
Prayer is the pillar of religion.
Prayer is the ascension of the believer.
Attend constantly to the matter of prayer, and guard it carefully.

arabic: جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْزِيهًا لَكُمْ عَنِ الْكِبْرِ
english: Allah made prayer a purification for you from arrogance.
source: Lady Fatima al-Zahra (a) — the Fadakiyya Sermon

arabic: أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ الصَّلَاةُ، فَإِنْ قُبِلَتْ قُبِلَ سَائِرُ عَمَلِهِ
english: The first thing the servant is called to account for is prayer; if it is accepted, the rest of his deeds are accepted.
source: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a) — Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih

arabic: قَلِيلٌ تَدُومُ عَلَيْهِ أَرْجَى مِنْ كَثِيرٍ مَمْلُولٍ مِنْهُ
english: A little that you persist in is more hopeful than much that wearies you.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَدْعُوهُ فَيُجِيبُنِي وَإِنْ كُنْتُ بَطِيئًا حِينَ يَدْعُونِي
english: Praise be to Allah, who answers me when I call Him — even though I am slow when He calls me.
source: Imam al-Sajjad (a) — Du'a Abu Hamza al-Thumali

arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُصَلِّي مَا يَغْشَاهُ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ لَمَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ
english: If the one who prays knew the mercy that envelops him, he would never lift his head from prostration.
